newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Rugby union-IRB name merit-based referee panel.
newsitem.headline: Rugby union-IRB name merit-based referee panel.

text.p: A pilot scheme to appoint the world's best rugby referees on merit rather than a rota basis will be in place for this year's Tri-Nation series involving South Africa, New Zealand and Australia.
Nine referees have been named by the International Rugby Board to form a merit-based panel, which will also supply the officials for next year's Five Nations championship.
Australia, New Zealand, England and Wales provide two referees apiece with Frenchman Joel Dume completing the list. South Africa, Ireland and Scotland fail to supply a representative between them.
The three-test series between South Africa and the British Lions in June and July will be controlled by three different referees from Australia, New Zealand and France.
July 19 S.Africa v N.Zealand - Peter Marshall (Aus)
July 26 Australia v N.Zealand - Ed Morrison (Eng)
Aug 2 Australia v S.Africa - Colin Hawke (NZ)
Aug 9 N.Zealand v S.Africa - Derek Bevan (Wales)
Aug 16 N.Zealand v Australia - Joel Dume (France)
Aug 23 S.Africa v Australia - Paddy O'Brien (NZ)
Other panel members: Brian Campsall (Eng), Wayne Erickson (Aus), Clayton Thomas (Wales).
